claims.claim: The camera is working perfectly fine.
claims.evidence: No test shots, menu/screen, or functional checks are shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: Selling with 2 batteries and a silicone case.
claims.evidence: Witness photos show only the Nikon D7000 body (and a lens cap nearby); no batteries, charger, or silicone case are shown.
No shutter count readout or camera screen/EXIF/status screen is shown.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: No lens is attached/shown clearly; photos do not provide a lens close-up to assess fungus/scratches.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No battery/charger labels or repair history documentation is shown.

risks.risk: Unclear completeness: photos show only the camera body (lens not shown attached) and do not confirm batteries/charger/case are included.
risks.proof: A single photo/clip showing all included items laid out together: camera body + both batteries + charger + memory card + silicone case (and any lens if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only / incomplete kit (worst-case: no lens, no charger, no extra battery).

risks.risk: Functional status not demonstrated (could have shutter/mirror/AF/controls issues).
risks.proof: A short video showing: power on, LCD/EVF display, menu navigation, autofocus on a target, and a test photo saved to the memory card.
Close-up photo of the sensor (or a sensor cleaning/dust check image) and a clear shot of the mirror area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible sensor dust/needs cleaning.

risks.risk: Screen/ports/buttons condition unknown (cracks, dead pixels, damaged ports).
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the LCD/EVF and a photo of all ports (USB/AV/HDMI if applicable) with the camera powered on.

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be inaccurate.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from the camera or a connected software readout (with the D7000 identified).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher usage than claimed.

risks.risk: Lens condition cannot be verified because no lens is shown attached.
risks.proof: If a lens is included: show the exact lens model and provide close-ups of front/rear elements for fungus/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as no lens included or lens condition unknown.

proof_requests: Show the full set of items included (camera body, both batteries, charger, silicone case, memory card, and any lens) laid out in one photo.
Provide a short power-on + menu + LCD/EVF working video, plus one test photo saved to the memory card.
Send a clear close-up of the sensor/mirror area (or a sensor dust check image).
Provide a shutter count readout screenshot/photo from the camera/software.
If a lens is included, show the lens model and close-ups of both elements for fungus/scratches.
response.reason: The witness report clearly identifies the item as a Nikon D7000 DSLR body, but key seller claims (working status, included accessories, shutter count, lens condition) are not verifiable from the photos. I can still price the identified body at a worst-case assumption for missing/untested accessories and condition.
